plan_and_detail_reconciliation.finding: Twenty single-duct and one series fan-powered terminal marks are literal schedule identities. Multi-room cells remain literal source cells and are not expanded into per-room terminal counts.
EG, RG and SD rows are air-device types/ranges, not plan-counted installed outlet instances; they remain schedule-row type identities.
The two filter rows both print ROOF location with no distinct equipment mark, so they are retained as source service/type rows rather than forced into duplicate physical identity keys.

All 38 valve rows print BALL VALVE with heating-hot-water supply/return service, size and flow. The source does not print Cv, actuator, control signal or fail position, so they are retained as manual ball-valve tags and excluded from BAS control-valve/actuator quantities.

control_valve_schedule.note: MH601 has a populated 38-row manual BALL VALVE schedule. It has no actuator, Cv, BAS signal, or fail-position fields, so it is not recast as a BAS control-valve schedule.

damper_actuator_schedule.note: Air-device schedule rows state damper/damper-diffuser properties but no damper actuator schedule, actuator model, torque, signal or fail position is printed.
